purpose: Track candidate official or high-trust sources before they are promoted into sources/feeds.json.
promotion_policy: Candidates must not be consumed by Daily Radar until promoted into sources/feeds.json through a separate reviewed PR.
Candidate URLs must be manually verified for stable RSS or Atom output before promotion.
Each promoted source must keep a source_class, keyword gates and an editorial rationale.
Official-source candidates should be preferred for streams with zero enabled official coverage in validation/source-governance-latest.*.

candidates.title: SEC Press Releases RSS Feed
candidates.rationale: SEC Press Releases are official regulatory announcements and can strengthen crypto-finance confirmation for enforcement, rulemaking and market-structure items. The SEC Press Releases page exposes a Press Releases RSS Feed link, but promotion still requires a production fetch/parse test and crypto-specific keyword gates.
verification_requirements: confirm the URL returns stable RSS or Atom content in the production fetch environment
confirm SEC source ownership and official status from the .gov source page
define include_keywords for crypto, digital assets, exchange, custody, enforcement, rulemaking and market structure
define exclude_keywords to avoid broad public-company and generic securities noise
confirm Daily Radar output improves confirmation rather than flooding finance/crypto-finance with generic SEC announcements
evidence: SEC Press Releases page identifies the page as an official SEC.gov page and links to a Press Releases RSS Feed.
Research note: raw RSS fetch still needs runtime validation before production promotion.
candidates.notes: Do not promote until runtime parsing is confirmed and crypto-specific gates are defined.

candidates.title: Additional official crypto-finance regulator / exchange / enforcement feed candidate
candidates.rationale: Source governance reports zero enabled official-source coverage for crypto-finance. Additional stable official regulator, exchange, court, enforcement or standards feeds may be useful only after URL verification.
verification_requirements: confirm the URL returns stable RSS or Atom content
confirm source ownership and official status
define include_keywords and exclude_keywords before promotion
confirm the source improves confirmation rather than adds market-noise
candidates.notes: Do not promote generic market-price feeds as official confirmation sources.

candidates.title: Stable official Moscow city feed replacement or fallback
candidates.rationale: mos-ru-news is disabled after repeated production timeouts, leaving moscow-city without enabled official-source coverage.
verification_requirements: verify a stable official Moscow RSS or Atom endpoint
confirm it does not timeout in production-like fetches
define city-service, transport and infrastructure keyword gates
keep mos-ru-news disabled unless stability is demonstrated
candidates.notes: A stable official fallback is preferable to re-enabling a timeout-prone feed.

candidates.title: Stable research journal or institutional science feed candidate
candidates.rationale: nature-news is disabled after XML parse errors; science-discovery keeps only one enabled high-trust research source.
verification_requirements: verify valid RSS or Atom XML
confirm source is a research journal, institution or high-trust science publication
define research-focused gates and exclude low-signal health/lifestyle topics
confirm generated signals include source attribution suitable for pre-publication review
candidates.notes: Do not re-enable nature-news until its endpoint parses reliably.

candidates.title: Official audio software / hardware vendor release feed candidate
candidates.rationale: dj-audio-creative has specialized media coverage but no official-source confirmation layer for product releases or platform changes.
verification_requirements: verify stable official vendor news or release feed
confirm source is not a marketing-only landing page without dated entries
define keyword gates for release, controller, mixer, plugin, driver and compatibility updates
ensure vendor source is not over-weighted as neutral editorial confirmation
candidates.notes: Official vendor feeds should complement, not replace, specialized media coverage.

candidates.title: Official brand / platform release feed candidate for gear-style-edc
candidates.rationale: gear-style-edc has public/specialized style coverage but no official-source confirmation layer for release and collaboration signals.
verification_requirements: verify stable official brand, retailer or platform feed
confirm dated release entries and durable URLs
define keyword gates for product releases, design, material, watch, bag, footwear and technical apparel
avoid turning brand marketing copy into editorial conclusion without corroboration
candidates.notes: Official brand feeds are useful as confirmation signals but require editorial framing.
